findings.highlight: the height is about sixteen centimeters.
findings.evidenceJa: 厚さにして六センチ強
findings.governingReading: The plastic box is slightly under fifteen centimeters each way and a little over six thick.
findings.explanation: A little over six centimeters becomes about sixteen centimeters.

findings.highlight: There, was just a girl sleeping.
findings.evidenceJa: ただの女の子の眠りだった
findings.governingReading: There is simply an ordinary girl asleep, stripped of combat labels in Shirou’s perception.
findings.explanation: A comma separates there from its existential verb.

findings.evidenceJa: 半身の麻痺は完治した
findings.governingReading: 半身の麻痺 identifies both the extent and a paralytic impairment, with Saber asking whether it is fully cured.
findings.explanation: Paralysis of half the body becomes unlocalized numbness.

findings.highlight: I have no place if my Master is still wounded.
findings.governingReading: 立つ瀬がない means she cannot justify her position/save face while her charge remains wounded, followed by relief at his ordinary kitchen activity.
findings.explanation: Saber’s untenable position becomes having no place.

findings.highlight: I'm too scared that I can't look back
findings.evidenceJa: こわくて居間に振り向けない
findings.governingReading: He is so afraid that he cannot turn toward the living room.
findings.explanation: Too scared that mixes two result constructions.
